title: FineWeb-Edu external-model taint (primary)
description: The entire cbase/c03 pretrain corpus includes FineWeb-Edu, a source whose document-inclusion decision was made by a classifier trained on Llama-3-70B-Instruct annotations. This violates INVARIANT clause 3 (CREATION) which requires freedom of contribution originating in any external model through any chain of intermediaries. All existing from-scratch checkpoints are affected.
quarantine: all from-scratch checkpoints without corpus rebuild

title: SFT-toolagent lineage has no receipted generator
description: The models/cbase-sft-toolagent{,-v2..v6}/model.pt checkpoints exist on disk with zero manifest, zero production receipt, and zero generator script anywhere in the tracked repo or working tree. Only 3 heavily-redacted scratch receipts confirm the training happened. The trace-generation mechanism is unknown, which per clause 3 is exclusion fail-closed.
quarantine: SFT-toolagent lineage excluded from creation claims until generator is receipted

title: Frozen-design-doc deviation: stack-v2 → codeparrot substitution
description: fp22-corpus-world.md row 1 specified the-stack-v2 as the code source; the actual pinned assembly used codeparrot/github-code-clean instead. This substitution was disclosed and acked (mail 14530) at the time, but it establishes that the pinned corpus already diverged from its frozen design under time pressure, representing the same class of risk as the FineWeb-Edu gap.
quarantine: disclosed at time of decision; flagged as standing risk pattern

title: C-BASE board condition does not audit clause-3 data provenance
description: The C-BASE board-GREEN status verifies that weights were not copied from a pretrained model (via net2net growth check) but says nothing about the corpus the from-scratch weights were trained on. A steward reading C-BASE:GREEN without this audit would incorrectly infer clause-3 cleanliness.
quarantine: C-INV probe now provides the corpus-audit check; C-BASE remains data-corpus-blind by design

title: Dynamic teacher system design is a live risk for future work
description: docs/research/teacher-system-2026-06-10.md proposes a design that would inject teacher-model-generated episode text into the training-signal path. The doc pre-dates the invariant draft and reasons from GOAL.md's older framing. If implemented as designed, it would fail clause 3 because gate-verification decides inclusion but the episode text's origin remains an external model.
quarantine: flagged for steward ruling before execution; never a model in the signal path
